creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`ghostty_surface_read_selection` hands over a selection's text and nothing hands over its bounds. That is why a word or line selection cannot be re-placed after a scroll the way a drag can.

`a_2Jrhh1dkA` shipped the workaround: keep the click count and re-drive two presses at the projected cell, which works only because a press more than one cell width from the last resets libghostty's count - and which needs a rule about never landing twice on the same cell, or the word becomes a line.

Two numbers would replace all of it. Muster owns the libghostty seam, so this is a legitimate upstream ask.
title: ⬆️ Upstream ghostty: a getter for a selection's start and end
